title: The standard modular-domain boundary is measurable and hyperbolically null
statement: Let ℍ = {x + iy ∈ ℂ : y > 0} carry its Borel measurable structure and hyperbolic measure μ = dx dy/y². Define F₀ = {z ∈ ℍ : 1 ≤ |z|² and |Re z| ≤ 1/2} and F₀° = {z ∈ ℍ : 1 < |z|² and |Re z| < 1/2}. Then E = F₀ \ F₀° is measurable and μ(E) = 0.
